title: V3 economy source rule catalogue (Track B, B1)

source.name: MovenRun Game Economy V3, revision 2, 31 August 2026
source.note: The source text is not committed. Section numbers are the source's.

classification_note: FIXED / HYPOTHESIS / STRUCTURAL / DELIBERATE / TARGET / FIXED · NOT GOVERNABLE are copied from the V3 §29 limits register. 'unlabelled' means the source states the rule in text or a table but §29 gives it no type. 'NOT IN SOURCE' rows come from code, pilot rule sets or owner decisions recorded in the repo, never from the source.
hosted_proof: None. Nothing in this catalogue was observed on a live system.

global_flags.token_status: No V3 token is deployed, issued, listed or saleable. V3 §1 and §31 say $MOVE does not trade and no token has reached a player. The gameplay server at this base settles off-chain credits only, behind a flag that is off by default; nothing is minted on any chain.
global_flags.emission_horizon: The 400,000,000 player allocation released over about 180 seasons (about 44 years) is a source allocation and release-schedule figure (V3 §17, §29). It is not circulating supply, not a valuation and not a forecast of issuance: the schedule is a maximum, ceiling trims are never issued, and no token exists.
global_flags.credits_vs_token_labelling: The source prices everything in $MOVE (one fungible token, locked or liquid state, V3 §21). The credits-only pilot (V3 §32 phase 1) settles off-chain game credits, which are not $MOVE in any state. At this base the reference model and the proposed tables still use token vocabulary for credits (MICRO_PER_MOVE, 'micro-MOVE', minted, burned: shared/src/domain/economyV3.ts:26-29,34,339,343; backend/drizzle-proposed/0011_gameplay_holdings.sql:553,557), while holdingSettlement.ts:14-19 and the API (backend/src/gameplay/router.ts:110-111) say credits. See SRC-LABEL-CREDITS-VS-TOKEN.

entries.mechanic: Hard total supply cap of $MOVE, no function to raise it
implementation: shared/src/constants/emission.ts:11 (older design, not imported by V3 code)
entries.implemented_value: No V3 total-supply constant in the reference model; the older-design token contract declares MAX_SUPPLY 1,000,000,000.
entries.recommended_resolution: Keep as an invariant for any future token contract. No V3 token contract exists; the older-design contract is a prototype inventory, not a product.
entries.notes: Not deployed or saleable as a V3 asset.

entries.mechanic: Player reward allocation released by movement only, over the season schedule
entries.implemented_value: 400,000,000 (micro-units); schedule releases exactly 400M across 180 seasons, the last partial (179.27 fractional seasons, 44.2 years).
entries.recommended_resolution: None for arithmetic. Always label it an allocation horizon, never circulating supply (see global_flags.emission_horizon).
entries.notes: Ceiling trims never cross a season and are never re-issued, so actual issuance can only be below this schedule.

entries.mechanic: Season pool: 9M in season one, 10% less each season, floor 2M
entries.implemented_value: Same; 15 seasons above the floor, then 2M per season until the allocation is exhausted.

entries.mechanic: Season length
entries.owner_decision_ref: D1 (season start day is required config)

entries.mechanic: Daily pool in season one, the only tap
entries.implemented_value: 100,000 in season one; season pool ÷ 90 later (90,000 in season two), an assumption.
entries.recommended_resolution: Ratify A3 or specify the later-season daily pool.

entries.mechanic: Per-session reward ceiling
Per-day, per-person reward ceiling
Ratio between the session and day ceilings; one session can never max a day
entries.implemented_value: 12/20 = 0.6, implied; no rules-version check enforces it.
entries.mismatch: The ratio is FIXED while both ceilings are HYPOTHESIS. Recalibrating either ceiling alone breaks the FIXED ratio. Nothing in code ties them.
entries.recommended_resolution: Add a rules-version validation that session ceiling ÷ day ceiling = 0.6 and day ceiling < 2 × session ceiling; owner to confirm that recalibration moves both together.

entries.mechanic: Order in which the two ceilings trim
entries.value: not stated ("trimmed by the two ceilings")
entries.implemented_value: Per-session ceiling first, then proportional trim to the day ceiling.
entries.mismatch: The order changes results. Sessions of effort 1.0 and 0.5 alone in a 100,000 pool: code gives [10, 10] = 20; day-first then session ceiling gives [12, 6.67] = 18.67. The split also changes the per-session toll.
entries.recommended_resolution: Owner ratifies A7 (session-first, proportional) or names the other order; record it in the rules version.

entries.mechanic: What a ceiling trims returns to the season pool, spreads across the season's remaining days, never crosses a season
entries.value: back to season pool; never crosses a season
entries.implemented_value: Trimmed amounts are counted as 'returned' and stay in the season, but the daily pool is a fixed season ÷ 90; nothing re-spreads them into later days.
entries.mismatch: §17 says trimmed amounts spread across the season's remaining days; the code never re-releases them.
entries.recommended_resolution: Owner specifies the spreading rule (for example remaining season pool ÷ remaining days) before it is built; until then report returned amounts as unissued.

entries.mechanic: Revenue valve: liquid issuance capped at real business revenue; excess mints locked
entries.mismatch: Not built. The credits pilot has no liquid state at all.
entries.recommended_resolution: Out of scope for the credits pilot; D11 (period and revenue definition) before any liquid phase, with legal sign-off (§32 phase 3).

entries.mechanic: Free players' rewards locked forever; after a first deed only later rewards are liquid; enforced in the token contract
entries.mismatch: Not built; the source requires contract-level enforcement and legal sign-off. The legal fallback (deed holders stay locked) is one configuration line in the source.
entries.recommended_resolution: Keep out of the credits pilot. Track under the contract research lane.

entries.mechanic: Staking allocation, deferred to phase 4
entries.implemented_value: No V3 staking; the older-design vault is a prototype.
entries.mismatch: V3 §31 says the public site describes staking as live; the source defers it.

entries.mechanic: Only verified movement creates value; land pays out of a runner's reward, never new supply
entries.implemented_value: Books check: minted ≤ pool; minted = credited + toll + burned; tolls paid = received.
entries.mismatch: The older-design token contract mints a 'zone tax' at mint time to the zone contract (contracts/src/MoveToken.sol:19,101-116), a different mechanic from the V3 toll (§31).
entries.recommended_resolution: None for the reference model. The older contract must not be reused for V3.

entries.mechanic: Sinks destroy value permanently and never free room to issue more
entries.implemented_value: Reference model counts 'burned' credits; repo contract source at this base calls _burn.
entries.mismatch: V3 §22 says the currently deployed contract transfers to treasury and calls it a burn. Deployed bytecode was not inspected (no chain access in this lane), so the repo source and the deployed prototype may differ.
entries.recommended_resolution: Contract lane to compare deployed bytecode with source offline from recorded artifacts; never reuse treasury-transfer burns.

entries.mechanic: Minimum session that counts
entries.recommended_resolution: None. Accessibility alternatives (§2) are not specified.

entries.mechanic: Pauses within 30 minutes merge into one session
entries.implemented_value: Not built (spec §7 'merge not built'); shared/src/domain/session.ts validates pauses only.
entries.mismatch: Splitting one walk into several sessions is not prevented by a merge rule; only the two-scoring-sessions cap limits it.
entries.recommended_resolution: Build the merge in the movement pipeline before any reward-scored pilot.

entries.mechanic: Sessions that score per day (a third still takes ground, streak, XP)
entries.implemented_value: Best two qualifying sessions by effort, ties to the earlier.

entries.mechanic: A session marked unscored before it starts: no charge, no tokens, still takes ground
entries.implemented_value: Supported by the reference model; the server never sets it (backend/src/gameplay/service.ts:985).
entries.mismatch: Not wired server-side: every qualifying session can score.
entries.recommended_resolution: Carry an 'unscored' flag from the verified session into settlement when the client can set it before start.

entries.mechanic: Effort curve √(minutes ÷ 40), floor 0.5, saturates at 40 min
entries.implemented_value: Same

entries.mechanic: Consistency multiplier ×1.00 rising to ×1.50 at six active days; a seventh adds nothing
entries.owner_decision_ref: A4 (linear +0.10 a day); D1 (what 'this week' is)
entries.implemented_value: Linear; the server counts active days over a rolling seven days ending on the settled day.
entries.mismatch: The source fixes only the end points (Meera's fifth day at ×1.40 fits linear). 'This week' is read as a rolling seven days, not a calendar week.
entries.recommended_resolution: Ratify A4 and the rolling-week reading.

entries.mechanic: Trust weight 0 to 1; withheld weight stays in the pool
entries.implemented_value: Applied after the pool split; pilot sets 1 for everyone (no trust service).
entries.mismatch: No trust service exists; every pilot account scores at full weight.
entries.recommended_resolution: Acceptable for a credits-only pilot; build before any locked-token phase.

entries.mechanic: Day-share: what the median active player earned that day; every price is in day-shares
entries.implemented_value: Median day reward after ceilings and trust, before charges, among players with a scoring session; lower middle.

entries.mechanic: Each scoring session uses 50% of the kit's charge
entries.implemented_value: Charge used = scoring sessions × 0.5, capped at 1; no charge state is stored.
entries.mismatch: Charge is derived, not held, so 'running with an empty kit' and Trail's carry-over (§10) cannot occur in code.
entries.recommended_resolution: Fine for the pilot with Starter kits only; decide D8 before kit levels ship.

entries.mechanic: Daily recharge = charge used × kit rate × the day's reward
entries.implemented_value: Same table; pilot fixes everyone at kit 1.

entries.mechanic: Recharge is computed on the day's gross reward, before the toll
entries.implemented_value: Gross day reward after ceilings and trust, before toll.

entries.mechanic: All automatic day-close charges (recharge + upkeep) at most 60% of the day's reward; the toll is not one of them
entries.implemented_value: Recharge first, upkeep taken up to the remaining cap, the rest reported as paid in condition; the toll is excluded.
entries.mismatch: Paid-in-condition upkeep changes no strength anywhere (D14 open), so unpaid upkeep currently has no consequence.

entries.mechanic: No cash top-up for charge; charge capacity not purchasable
entries.implemented_value: No purchase path exists in the gameplay code read (backend/src/gameplay/, shared/src/domain/).
entries.recommended_resolution: Keep as a negative invariant in review checklists.

entries.mechanic: Running with an empty kit is always allowed; earns everything but tokens
implementation: backend/src/gameplay/service.ts:375-411 (ground is pushed regardless of scoring)
entries.implemented_value: Ground pushes do not depend on charge; there is no charge state to empty.

entries.mechanic: Nothing is claimed until sealed; three ways to seal (within 150 m of start, finish on own ground, cross own trail); unsealed runs still earn
entries.implemented_value: Sealing engine built (150 m, own-ground method unavailable until held ground exists). The gameplay server pushes every unit of every verified session as a solid claim and never reads the session's sealed flag.
entries.mismatch: Rule 3 is not enforced server-side under 1001 or 1002: an unsealed session claims ground. movement_verifications records 'sealed' (backend/src/movement/repositories/interfaces.ts:60) but applySession does not select it.
entries.recommended_resolution: Gate pushes from a session on its server-derived seal result (or record the deviation explicitly for owner ratification for the pilot). Do not let the client declare a seal.

entries.mechanic: Solid claim strength (cells physically stepped on)
entries.owner_decision_ref: A1 (interpolated cells are not stepped on)
entries.mismatch: Under 1002 interpolated res10 units are pushed as solid (see PILOT-RES10-INTERPOLATION).

entries.mechanic: Shade (enclosed, never entered) strength 25 × shape × sprawl
entries.implemented_value: Ceiling 25 enforced; shade strength is an input; no geometry computes it and the server pushes no shade.
entries.mismatch: Shade is not built (D2 shape metric and sprawl curve open).

entries.mechanic: Shade sprawl bound: up to 12 enclosed cells per stepped cell at full strength
entries.mismatch: Not built.

entries.mechanic: Shade decays three times faster than solid
Shade can never be deeded and never collects a toll; anyone who walks it takes it at full strength
entries.implemented_value: Deeded ground must be solid; stepped-on shade flips at 100.

entries.mechanic: Restricted areas (military, schools, hospitals, shelters, private land, hazards) unclaimable at any strength
entries.implemented_value: Masked units refuse every push; no mask data source exists.
entries.mismatch: D3 (mask data source) open, so in practice nothing is masked.
entries.recommended_resolution: Decide D3 before any real-geography pilot.

entries.mechanic: A walker's push subtracts from strength; at zero the cell flips to them carrying the overflow
entries.implemented_value: 1001: immediate flip; new holder at max(1, overflow), so 100 vs 100 leaves 1.
entries.mismatch: The source does not say what an exact zero overflow leaves; A9 keeps 1.

entries.mechanic: Walking your own cell resets it to 100, free
Strength drains daily from the last visit through held, at risk, contested, dormant, back on the map
entries.implemented_value: Parameters; pilot values in PILOT-SOLID-DECAY and PILOT-STAGE-FLOORS.

entries.mechanic: Deeded cells never wear down; taken only by formal contest
entries.implemented_value: Deeded units do not decay and refuse pushes; deeds cannot be created (not built).

entries.mechanic: Upkeep per unvisited zone = 0.03 day-shares × zones held^0.25
entries.unit: day-shares per unvisited zone per day
entries.owner_decision_ref: D5 (what a zone is), D15 (shade as held)
entries.implemented_value: Formula as written × level multiplier (1.00/1.00/0.95/0.90/0.85).
entries.mismatch: §7 table's 16-zone row prints 1.00 / 7.0 per week; the formula gives 0.96 / 6.72. The repo's own test accepts it with a 0.05 tolerance.
entries.recommended_resolution: Treat the formula as authoritative and the table row as a rounded illustration; owner to confirm.

entries.mechanic: Fourteen free away-protection days per season
entries.implemented_value: Reference model accepts an awayProtected flag; the server never sets it (backend/src/gameplay/service.ts:987-995).
entries.mismatch: A FIXED free protection is not available in the pilot server: unvisited zones are charged every day.
entries.recommended_resolution: Decide D17 and wire it before upkeep has any consequence (D14).

entries.mechanic: Unpayable upkeep is paid in condition; balances never go negative
entries.implemented_value: Never negative; condition effect reported only.
entries.mismatch: No strength effect (D14).

entries.mechanic: Five land levels costing 2 to 45 day-shares, burned; resistances and upkeep multipliers per level
entries.implemented_value: Resistances and upkeep multipliers as the table; purchases not built.
entries.mismatch: Losing a zone resets it to level 1 (holding.ts:180, 271) instead of 'drops two levels'; 14-day restore not modelled (D16).

entries.mechanic: Five kit levels costing 3 to 50 day-shares, burned
entries.implemented_value: Rates only; purchases not built; pilot at kit 1.

entries.mechanic: Decay resistance from level + fortify at most +50%; erosion resistance at most +40%
A level adds nothing to a contest and 1.00× to toll income
entries.implemented_value: Toll has no level input; contests not built.

entries.mechanic: Losing a zone drops two levels; full restore if reclaimed within 14 days
entries.implemented_value: Lost ground resets to level 1; no restore.
entries.mismatch: Differs from the FIXED rule.
entries.recommended_resolution: Decide D16 and implement before levels can be bought.

entries.mechanic: Fortification: +30% decay resistance, −30% erosion, up to 3 active per zone, each expires, at most +15% in a contest
entries.implemented_value: A single boolean 'fortified'; no count of three, no expiry, no price; contests not built.
entries.mismatch: Three slots and expiry are not modelled (D9 price and duration open).
entries.recommended_resolution: Decide D9; model slots when fortify is built.

entries.mechanic: Deed: 21 consecutive days tenure; 30 distinct verified people over 10 days; no related cluster above 20%; own and linked traffic never counts; solid only; per-city cap; claim fee burned
entries.mismatch: Not built. Under 1002, interpolated units would count as stepped ground for any future traffic metric unless excluded.
entries.recommended_resolution: Decide D6; when built, count crossers from stepped units only.

entries.mechanic: Deeds per person per city capped at a published share
entries.mismatch: FIXED in the register, but no value is given anywhere in the source.

entries.mechanic: Contest: burned fee and escrow; 72 h notice; 7-day window, best 3 days; 5-10% home advantage; club support budget; 30-day attacker lockout, 14-day defender peace
entries.mismatch: Not built. Home advantage is HYPOTHESIS in §29; notice/window and cooldowns are FIXED.

entries.mechanic: Toll: 2% of a session's reward, once, in total, however many owners crossed
entries.implemented_value: 200 basis points × share of distinct crossed cells on other people's deeds, per scoring session.
entries.mismatch: §18 Meera applies it to the whole day's reward (3.68 × 2% × 0.25 = 0.0184); §20's per-session reading of the same inputs gives 0.0092 if the evening session crossed the 12 cells. The code follows §20 and reproduces 0.0184 only if the evening session crossed 6 cells.
entries.recommended_resolution: Owner decides D10; then correct either the §18 worked example or the code.

entries.mechanic: Toll splits by deeded cells crossed, per owner
entries.implemented_value: Same

entries.mechanic: Crossing more owners costs nothing extra; the toll never exceeds 2% (no 50-deed or any other surcharge)
entries.implemented_value: Total ≤ 2% by construction; books check enforces it per day.

entries.mechanic: Own land and linked accounts' land free; laps count once per cell per session; rounding remainders go to the runner; shade never tolls
entries.implemented_value: Distinct cells; owner and linked skipped; per-owner floors, remainder stays with the runner. Linked ids are an input; the server passes none (no risk graph).
entries.mismatch: No linked-account source exists, so 'linked' exclusion is empty in the pilot.
entries.recommended_resolution: Acceptable while tolls are credits; required before any deed phase.

entries.mechanic: Total toll to all owners in season one cannot exceed 2% of the season pool
entries.implemented_value: Implied by per-day ≤ 2% and minted ≤ pool.

entries.mechanic: One owner's daily toll income has no cap
entries.implemented_value: No cap on received tolls.

entries.mechanic: Route never on chain: no raw GPS, no lists of map cells; toll is a matched debit and credit
entries.implemented_value: Nothing is written on chain; server stores res10 cell paths off-chain (backend/src/gameplay/path.ts:31-34).
entries.recommended_resolution: Keep cell lists out of any settlement commitment.

entries.mechanic: Governance over the toll or the supply cap is impossible
Rewards settle once a day among the people who moved that day; settlement halts if the books do not balance
entries.implemented_value: Day = UTC day of the last verified fix; close at midnight + 2 h grace (pilot); a day with any problem is refused whole.
entries.mismatch: D1 day attribution (UTC, last fix) is a pilot proposal; players in other time zones see a UTC day.

entries.mechanic: A pause covers new claims and settlement only, never withdrawals
entries.implemented_value: No withdrawals exist in the credits pilot.

entries.mechanic: Sponsored actions per account per day, gated on having played; zero for a brand-new account
entries.mismatch: Not built (no paymaster).

entries.mechanic: Raw GPS and sensor retention
entries.implemented_value: Not met today (spec §6.4). Gameplay route cell lists proposed at 14 days (see PILOT-RETENTION-14-120).
entries.mismatch: Res10 cell paths are a route at about 76 m granularity and are kept far longer than the raw-location target.
entries.recommended_resolution: Owner decides retention for derived cell paths explicitly.

entries.mechanic: No paid season track and no purchasable streak shields
Credits-only pilot versus $MOVE (one fungible token, locked or liquid)
entries.implemented_value: Credits in the settlement and API; token vocabulary (MOVE, minted, burned) in the reference model and proposed columns.
entries.mismatch: Labels mix credits and token terms. Not a functional defect, but a reader of the tables or exports could take credits for $MOVE.
entries.recommended_resolution: Name pilot columns and exports in credit terms (issued, removed) or annotate them as credits; keep '$MOVE' for the token only.

entries.mechanic: Per-walker daily budget of takes (pushes on someone else's ground), met in walk order
entries.origin: sim-pilot-2 churn study (docs/SIM_CHURN_STUDY.md lines 107-110, 122, 136, 142): 5 × 201/76 ≈ 13; rule set 1002 only
entries.implemented_value: 13, walk-order-v1
entries.mismatch: No V3 rule matches; it is a new reach limit.

entries.mechanic: Per-walker daily budget of verified units (capacity guard)
entries.origin: storage capacity study (docs/G34_STORAGE_CAPACITY.md); a capacity guard, not a game rule
entries.mismatch: A walker whose session exceeds the budget loses claims the source would grant; not disclosed in source.
entries.recommended_resolution: Disclose to players if it ever bites; keep as an operational guard.

entries.mechanic: Second push of a two-day challenge must arrive at least 20 hours after the first, by server receipt
entries.mismatch: Deviates from V3 §5 immediate flip at zero (delays it further).
entries.recommended_resolution: Formal ratification, change or drop together with the two-day challenge.

entries.mechanic: Two-day challenge: flip only on a second push on an earlier day within the window; otherwise leave at the floor; ground below the immediate line falls at once
entries.origin: sim-pilot-2 churn study (docs/SIM_CHURN_STUDY.md line 141); rule set 1002
entries.mismatch: V3 §5: 'when it hits zero the cell flips to them'. 1002 does not flip at zero on a first push.
entries.recommended_resolution: Owner ratifies, changes or drops 1002; 1001 stays the default.

entries.mechanic: Units are H3 resolution 10 cells (about 76 m); upkeep zones are their resolution 9 parents (about 201 m), split per holder
entries.source_section: none (source tolls and deeds cells, charges upkeep per zone, defines neither)
entries.origin: sim-pilot-2 (docs/SIM_CHURN_STUDY.md line 110); rule set 1002; 1001 uses the stored resolution 8 cell as unit and zone
entries.implemented_value: res10 / res9, per-holder-min-level-v1

entries.mechanic: 1002 session path: units crossed by the straight segment between consecutive accepted fixes (sampled every 8 m) are pushed as solid
entries.source_section: none (V3 §3, §4: cells you stepped on become solid)
entries.origin: rule set 1002 path rule verified-steps v1 (docs/G34_SERVER_ARCHITECTURE.md lines 230, 343, 359)
entries.implemented_value: Interpolated units claim, erode, flip and count as visits (pushKind 'solid'); the toll reads stepped units only.
entries.mismatch: Inferred ground is treated as stepped for claims, takes, defence and upkeep visits, against A1 and the source's 'cells you stepped on'. Future deed traffic would inherit it unless excluded.
entries.recommended_resolution: Flagged for formal owner ratification and integrity testing; not resolved here. Options: pushInterpolated false; or interpolated units as a distinct push kind that never takes or deeds.

entries.mechanic: Each walker may push a unit someone else holds at most once per day; claiming and reinforcing unlimited; a flip does not reset the day
entries.unit: hostile pushes per walker per unit per day
entries.origin: Owner decision recorded as A9; enforced by applyPush and by a unique index in proposed 0011
entries.implemented_value: 1; verified that a walker who flipped a unit and lost it back the same day is refused a second push.
entries.mismatch: Not a V3 source rule. It does not authorise any extra hostile push after a flip, and it is a limit on top of §5, not a reading of it.
entries.recommended_resolution: Keep labelled as an owner decision, not source.

entries.mechanic: Solid decay per day without a visit
Stage floors held / at risk / contested
Retention proposal: raw push ledger and cell lists 14 days; player-day proofs 120 days
entries.source_section: none (V3 §27 sets only the 24-72 h raw-location TARGET)
entries.origin: docs/G34_STORAGE_CAPACITY.md (recommendation and retention table); proposal only, no job deletes anything
entries.implemented_value: 14 / 120 as a projection input

entries.mechanic: Pilot size target on the current database quota
entries.mismatch: Below the source's phase 1 range of 1,000-5,000 players; a storage constraint, not a game rule.
entries.recommended_resolution: State it as a capacity limit, not a phase 1 pilot in the source's sense.

entries.mechanic: Session day = UTC day of the last verified fix; day close at midnight + 2 h grace
entries.implemented_value: offset 0, grace 7,200,000 ms

entries.mechanic: Ground held only as shade does not count as a held zone for upkeep
